title: Kagamine Rin — Happy Anniversary! 2023〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: After school
Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Main Gate

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Minori, Haruka, we're here!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Sorry for keeping you waiting. Homeroom dragged on for—huh?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
<Hey, no worries♪
We kept ourselves occupied by watching a video!>

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh! Rin, you're already here.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Yeah! You guys are buying some stuff for Len and me, right?!>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Thanks for coming on such short notice. We're getting some cake and other things to mark the occasion, and we figured we should find out what you want to have.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Cake! I wonder what kinds they have? Now you've really got my attention!>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: By the way, you said you were in the middle of watching something. What was it?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Since the teaser for Rin and Len's anniversary show dropped recently, we decided to check it out.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Oh, that! It has some behind-the-scenes snippets weaved in there, too!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I have to admit, I haven't seen it yet, but I was meaning to.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Huh? You're missing out! The show's tomorrow, you have to watch it today!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Uh-huh♪ Since it's quite short, how about we watch it now?>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: And take up your valuable time? Well, if you're sure. I wanna watch it too!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Let's see. Where's my phone...?
VIRTUAL SINGER Stage

rows.Speaker: Rin & Len
rows.Line: Hello everyone!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: It's Kagamine Rin...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: And Kagamine Len!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Do you guys know what makes December 27th so special?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: It's our anniversary! And what's a better way to celebrate than with an anniversary show?!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Ding, ding, ding! And we'll be the ones performing♪

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Ahaha! We'll be giving you a sneak peek behind the scenes as we prep for the big day!

rows.Speaker: Rin & Len
rows.Line: Without further ado, let's begin♪

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. Just look at their beaming faces!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah, it's like they're beside themselves waiting for their anniversary to come.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Hehehe. As it turns out, Len and I were getting things ready for our show in SEKAI just before I arrived here!>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <So seeing these versions of us doing the same thing has me all excited!>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: From what Rin was telling Minori and me earlier, it sounds like everything's coming together quite nicely.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: We've also got our own roles to fulfill in all this, so let's give it everything we've got!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: After all, we're doing this for Rin and Len, who have always been there for us.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Nicely said.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Like that time I had snapped at Shizuku and was feeling sad. It was Rin who came to cheer me up.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Then there was another time when the stress of whether to sign up to an agency got to me...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Is there some kind of rule that says idols have to be part of one of these agencies you mentioned?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Take this SEKAI, for example. All of these different stages were created through everyone's feelings, right?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: You have as many wonderful feelings here, so I feel like you'd be capable of anything if you put your minds to it.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: The four of you are sure to become an idol group that can give hope to anyone, anywhere!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: That's what I believe!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Rin gave me the boost I desperately needed.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: And when we were going to have our first ever joint show, she was there for me.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: The others are so great at being idols and I wanted to be just like them...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I knew that it wouldn't be easy either...!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: But it feels like nothing I do is working. It feels like I'm never gonna be able to become a real idol like them...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I understand how you feel!!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Miku and Luka are so amazing at singing and dancing, and they never make any mistakes!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: So I always feel like I'm the one that's holding them back sometimes...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I keep hoping that I'll be like them someday...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: When she told me that she was also going through the same thing, it gave me such a sense of relief.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Minori...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: And it's not just that. It gave me so much courage too! Now's the time to pay her back by putting every ounce of our energy into this show!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
<Hehehe...
Gosh, guys... I feel like you're speaking so highly of me.>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: That's because we are, silly. We're not exaggerating when we say you've done so much for us.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hehe, I feel like Rin's the kind of person who lights up every room she walks in.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: When we go to SEKAI, her excited voice is enough to draw us to where she is.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes! The trail always leads to Rin and the others!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah! The difference Rin makes to the atmosphere is like night and day!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
<I-I dunno...
That sounds a bit too good to be true...>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <But I'm happy you feel that way about me♪>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: So, how do you guys think our show is shaping up?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Watching Miku and Luka lose their minds trying to find the end of a suuuper long cable was so adorable!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: They almost never lose their cool, so their confused faces were a rare sight!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: And that wraps up today's video! Hope you enjoyed it!♪

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Rin and I each have our own part for the show, and we can't wait to deliver our jam-packed program!

rows.Speaker: Rin & Len
rows.Line: We hope to see you then!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Ah! What an exciting teaser!
It really gave us a taste of each of the different segments we can look forward to!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, now we really can't miss out on this Rin and Len's show!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: We sure can't! But in the meantime, that shopping won't do itself!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Ah, we should probably go preorder the cake first.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Then, we should buy a ton of snacks and juice!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Eep! I'm so excited for the party tomorrow♪>
